entries.title: Type into a crewmate's browser as soon as it is handed to you
entries.body: When a crewmate asks for your help on a page and you press its card's button to open the browser, your typing now goes straight to the page once it is yours, so you can enter a user name or password without clicking the page first.
entries.noPicture: Where your typing goes cannot show in a still picture; the page looks the same.
